description: Questions a blind user would ask out loud. The tester clicks the app's own question buttons (the same questions the voice button would send) and checks whether each one gets a SPOKEN answer — not just words on a screen.
name: Daily Meds Helper — voice-first smoke test

questions.spoken: Did I take my morning pills?
What time is my evening dose?

targetNote: Local copy of the live Daily Meds Helper deploy, served on localhost because this VM's Chromium cannot reach the internet through the egress proxy (all proxy forms fail with ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED; curl works). Every file is byte-identical to the live deploy (verified by download + diff on Nov 24, 2026) except src/config.js, which is the placeholder locally (demo mode, deterministic schedule answers) while the live deploy has the Firebase config injected at deploy time (cloud AI answers). The import map points at the local Firebase SDK in node_modules instead of the gstatic CDN; in demo mode the SDK is never called. All UI, speech and schedule code under test is identical to the live deploy.
